items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, vs S&P 500 +13.9%. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on the stock amid softer China EV demand, elevated inventories and expected supply from mine restarts (e.g. Bald Hill, May 2026).

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of talks ahead of a strike; the proposal must be ratified by member vote. If the strike is averted, prolonged supply disruption risk is resolved.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in H1 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May; stationary storage (LFP) drives the gap. US Commerce imposed a one-year block on black mass exports Aug 6.
